verdict.rationale: Lorikeet is a SaaS customer-support platform, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a fair thing to ask about. The evidence pack documents only an MCP server, MCP skills and an llms.txt index. The MCP 'Test tools' feature validates a customer's own tool configurations from an AI assistant; it is not an explorable API reference, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
